label: Guide me: Import old returns

params.name: lede
params.default: Bring a client's past returns into {product} - the return as filed, the client record and next year's statement ready to fill.
params.label: lede

default.title: Upload the return
default.say: The ITR JSON as filed - from incometax.gov.in or the offline utility. {product} reads the form, the year, the person and every figure.

default.title: Whose return?
default.say: The client with the same PAN is picked for you. No such client? Create one from the return - and start this year for them if they have not come yet.

default.title: Record it as filed
default.say: Give the acknowledgement number and the date filed. A revised or updated return takes the place of the one standing; the same return twice is refused.

default.title: The statements
default.say: Download the statement as filed, and next year's statement with last year's figures beside each line - ready to fill and upload.

description_nl: 2026-10-04: the Import old returns walk, up to date with the screen; tours/sf-itrimport.json is made from it.
